EOF
pwd && git status --short && rg --files -g '"'!*lock*'"' | head -160"

item.text: I found the shared `subscriptionExpires` helper and the cancellation confirmation date renderers. Both currently prefer the upcoming subscription’s period end, so I’m checking every cancellation screen that displays an end date before wiring them through the helper.
